description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView to display logging information received through the LogNode interface. It formats and outputs log messages, including handling different log levels and exceptions.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView component that outputs log data received through the LogNode interface, formatting and displaying log messages within an Android activity.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats the log data with priority, tag, message, and exception info, then updates the UI and passes the log to the next LogNode if set.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string and delimiter to a StringBuilder if the string is not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView.
